# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking, ungainly man with stooping shoulders and long, iron-gray hair touching his shoulders. He wears a full, soft brown beard that he has kept since he was twenty years old.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew is exceptionally shy, quiet, and reserved, avoiding strangers and places where he might have to speak. Despite his bashful nature, he is deeply sympathetic, soft-hearted, patient, and a kindly listener. He holds fast to his opinions with an amazing silent persistency that often wins out over Marilla's objections. He naturally enjoys spoiling Anne Shirley and indulging her wishes without hesitation.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c13 P6](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0006), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. Due to his advancing age and failing heart, he and Marilla arranged to adopt a young boy from an asylum to help on the farm. Upon driving to Bright River station, he found Anne Shirley waiting instead, and despite his terror of little girls, he immediately took a liking to her endless chatter. Matthew quietly insisted on keeping Anne at Green Gables, gradually persuading Marilla to agree. He became Anne's devoted friend and supporter, taking great delight in indulging her, including secretly getting her a stylish dress with puffed sleeves. Years later, Matthew died instantly of a heart attack on the kitchen threshold after reading news of the failure of the Abbey Bank.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Raised at Green Gables in the secluded house built by his father  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Lived a quiet life rarely leaving home due to intense shyness  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007)</sub>
